description: A mysterious hidden-gaze sigil: two narrow opposing crescents framing one vertical slit of pale light. It suggests an unseen presence looking through its host, without drawing a literal eyeball. Minimal strange asymmetrical negative space. Single flat pixel-art game UI glyph on transparent background. Readable at 18 pixels, broad clean pixel strokes, minimal detail, at most 3 colors: dark ink outline, muted bone ivory body, one tiny desaturated violet accent. No object, no medallion, no metallic frame, no raised surface, no coin, no round badge background, no shadow, no flame, no sparkle cluster, no letters, no text. Whole glyph centered with generous transparent margin on every side.
